name: recent login and real phone binding required; no identity delegation or arbitrary fields
create and SMS retry are idempotent, bound to original session and account
ordinary login proof cannot change phone, wrong proofs commit capped attempts without double counting retries
manual resend near request expiry returns the active challenge, not an older code with the same deadline
unknown delivery does not resend automatically; cancellation and expiry retire codes and encrypted phones
both proofs required; complete change preserves account and parties, revokes all old sessions and old pending login codes
claimed target never merges accounts and concurrent claim cannot overwrite another user
failed audit rolls back phone mapping, sessions and result so original confirmation can recover
phone replacement preserves account and requires separate original/new proofs
